thread.title: As iPhone sales slump, the good news for Apple is that its higher prices mean customers are spending more on phones (AAPL)

author: Troy Wolverton
title: As iPhone sales slump, the good news for Apple is that its higher prices mean customers are spending more on phones (AAPL)
text: As iPhone sales slump, the good news for Apple is that its higher prices mean customers are spending more on phones (AAPL) By Troy Wolverton Jan 28, 2019, 9:05 pm 17 pts Apple iPhone price hikes have led to customers spending more money for their phones, UBS analyst Timothy Arcuri said in a new report. More than 70% of iPhone purchasers in December spent at least $700 for a device, up from about 45% a year earlier. More customers are buying the latest iPhones, and…
